newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
ALBANIA, Sept 9 - Durres - Three vessels in port, all discharging, of which 1 bagged cement, 1 bagged flour, 1 bulk wheat. 1 Vessel waiting in roads to discharge bagged flour.

BULGARIA, Sept 2-8 - Bourgas - 28 Vessels in port operating of which 21 loading (2 clinker, 2 copper cathodes, 1 general cargo, 1 paper, 1 metal, 2 fertiliser, 1 benzol, 1 trucks, 4 steel, 1 copper concentrates, 1 metal/containers, 2 tankers, 1 chemicals, 1 baryte concentrate). 7 Discharging (1 sugar, 1 fish meal, 1 coal, 2 zinc concentrate, 2 crude oil). 11 Waiting in roads of which 6 to load (1 cars, 3 tankers, 1 fertiliser, 1 fish), 2 to discharge (1 potatoes, 1 other vessel), 3 cargo not nominated. 11 Due of which 4 to load (1 general cargo, 1 metal, 2 steel). 6 To discharge (1 fertiliser, 1 steel, 1 coke, 1 cars, 1 coal, 1 iron ore), 1 to discharge/load containers.

Varna - East/West/Balchik, Tuapse - 31 Vessels operating of which 18 loading (6 soda, 1 kaolin, 4 fertiliser, 2 clinker, 1 cement, 1 scrap, 2 quartz sand, 1 glass). 6 Discharging (1 sugar, 1 coke, 1 phosphorite, 2 coal, 1 granite), 2 discharging/loading trucks/containers, 5 discharging/loading containers. 11 In roads of which 1 to load urea, 1 to discharge granite, 5 to discharge/load containers, 3 cargo not nominated, 1 awaiting cargo. Sept 9 - No labour problems. Varna east - 3 Vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging, 1 waiting at anchor to load, 1 to discharge, 2 awaiting orders. Varna west - 7 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchor to load, 2 to discharge. Varna Lesport, tanker port - no vessels.

Bourgas east - 3 Vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging, 6 waiting at anchor to load, 2 to discharge. 8 under repair/dry-docked, 4 awaiting orders, 8 due. Bourgas west - 4 Discharging at berth, 6 due. Tanker port - 1 loading at berth, 1 discharging, 3 waiting at anchor to load.

CROATIA, Sept 9 - Rasa - One vessel discharging at berth. Rijeka - One vessel discharging at berth, 2 loading, 1 berthed but not operating, 8 under repair/dry-docked. 1 Anchored, 7 due, delays expected. Zadar - One vessel due, delays expected. Split - Two vessels discharging at berth, 1 loading. Ploce - Four vessels discharging at berth. Pula, Sibenik, Dubrovnik - No vessels.

CYPRUS, Sept 10 - Limassol - Five vessels loading at berth, 6 discharging. No vessels anchored, 11 due 11/9 of which 5 containers, 5 passenger, 1 conventional vessel. Larnaca - No vessels operating, none waiting, 1 container vessel due 11/9.

ESTONIA, Sept 9 - Tallinn city port - 4 Vessels loading at berth (1 iron alloys, 1 iron ore pellets, 1 pig iron, 1 empty containers), 1 liner. 3 Vessels due, no delays. Kopli - No vessels, no delays. Muuga - Vessels loading at berth (3 black oil, 2 fertiliser, 1 petrol, 1 paper), 2 ferries. 3 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load. No delays. Parnu - Two vessels loading at berth (1 timber, 1 peat), 2 vessels due. No delays.

ITALY, Sept 10 - Naples - One bulk carrier etb 13/9. Gaeta, Salerno - No vessels in roads. Genoa commercial port - No vessels in roads, no delays, 32 berthed, 6 in dry-dock. Multedo oil harbour - 4 Vessels in roads, 4 berthed. Savona - No vessels in roads, no delays, 5 berthed. Vado Ligure - No vessels in roads, no delays, 1 berthed. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays, 5 berthed, 4 under repair. Leghorn - Three in roads, no delays, 36 berthed. Civitavecchia, Gaeta, Naples, Palermo, Anna/ Falconara, Trieste - No vessels in roads, no delays. Augusta - Oil harbour - 4 in roads, 4 berthed. Syracuse - Oil harbour - 2 in roads, 3 berthed. Sarroch - No vessels in roads, no delays, 5 berthed. Taranto - Two vessels in roads totalling 9,889 dwt. Ravenna - Four in roads. Venice - No information received.

LATVIA, Sept 10 - No strikes in any port. Riga - 17 Vessels in port of which 14 operating, 7 timber loaders, 2 cotton loaders, 1 melon loader, 2 container loaders, 1 chicken discharger, 1 fish discharger, 3 waiting, no delays, 16 due. Ventspils - Six in port, all operating, 1 timber, 2 steel, 1 mop, 2 cotton. No vessels waiting, no delays, 5 due. Liepaja - Eight in port, all operating, none waiting/due, no delays.
LITHUANIA, Sept 9 - Klaipeda - 8 Vessels loading (3 metal, 2 cement, 3 fertiliser), 6 discharging (3 fish, 3 soy pellets) 1 loading/discharging. 1 Vessel in roads, 23 Vessels due.

POLAND, Sept 10 - Szczecin - 41 Vessels loading at berth, 28 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchor to discharge, 10 under repair/dry-docked, 72 due. Gdynia - Ten vessels operating of which 5 loading at berth (1 coal, 1 bulker, 3 general cargo). 4 Discharging (1 bulker, 2 general cargo, 1 fuel), 1 awaiting orders. 11 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 30 due. Gdansk - 11 Vessels operating of which 8 loading at berth (3 coal, 2 bulkers, 3 general cargo), 3 discharging at berth (1 ore, 1 bulker, 1 fuel), 6 under repair/dry-docked, 14 vessels due.

PORTUGAL, Sept 9 - Leixoes - 11 Vessels operating of which 8 general cargo, 3 containers. No vessels waiting, 9 vacant places of which 7 piers with cranes, 2 piers without cranes. Setubal, Sept 10 - Nine vessels berthed and operating of which 4 loading, 5 discharging. 9 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 15 due of which 9 to discharge, 6 to load.

ROMANIA, Sept 10 - Constanta - 39 Vessels operating of which 21 general cargo (19 loading, 2 discharging). 6 Bulkers (3 loading, 3 discharging), 7 bagged chemicals, 1 tanker, 3 bagged cement (all loading). 1 Container discharging, 6 in roads of which 3 general cargo, 1 bulker, 2 chemicals (all to load). Constanta south (Agigea) - 8 General cargo, 1 bulker (all loading) Mangalia - No vessels. Midia - Three livestock carriers loading.

RUSSIA, Sept 9 - Baltic ports - St. Petersburg - 16 Vessels operating of which 6 discharging (1 sugar, 1 frozen meat, 1 frozen chicken, 1 general cargo, 1 containers, 1 fodder), 10 loading (3 non-ferrous metals, 3 fertiliser, 1 general cargo, 1 containers, 1 scrap, 1 silicon). 8 Vessels waiting, 21 vessels due. Conditions Sept 10 - No strikes at any port. Kaliningrad - Seven vessels in port, all operating, of which 1 coal loader, 1 fertiliser loader, 2 scrap loader, 1 seed loader, 1 sugar discharger, 1 meal discharger. No vessels waiting, no delays, 1 vessel due. Vyborg - Six vessels in port of which 4 operating as follows, 1 fertiliser discharger, 1 fish discharger, 1 steel discharger, 3 coal loaders. 2 Waiting with no delays expected, 3 vessels due.

Black Sea ports - Novorossiysk - Sept 9 - Nine vessels in port operating of which 4 loading (1 construction materials, 1 steel, 1 fertiliser, 1 seeds), 5 discharging (3 various, 1 rice, 1 sugar) 6 vessels waiting in roads of which 3 to load (1 rice, 1 copper, 1 steel), 3 to discharge (2 rice, 1 luggage). 19 Vessels due of which 13 to load (3 scrap, 7 steel, 1 asbestos, 1 cellulose, 1 rape). 6 To discharge (2 sugar, 2 rice, 1 luggage, 1 aeroplanes). Oil terminal, Sept 10 - 3 Tankers berthed of which 2 loading crude oil, 1 fuel oil. 5 Vessels waiting in roads to load crude oil. 7 Tankers due of which 6 to load crude oil, 1 diesel oil. Northern basin - Murmansk, Sept 10 - Six vessels operating of which 1 alumina, 1 wheat meal, 1 steel, 1 scrap, 1 npk, 1 cabotage. 2 vessels waiting to load of which 1 alumina, 1 npk. 7 Vessels due during the week of which 5 loaders (4 apatite, 1 cabotage), 2 dischargers (1 alumina, 1 cabotage).

SLOVENIA Sept 9 - Koper - 11 Vessels berthed of which 5 loading (2 general cargo, 1 bulker, 1 reefer, 1 livestock). 4 Discharging (1 reefer, 2 bulkers, 1 chemical tanker), 2 loading/discharging (1 ferry, 1 containers). 20 Due over next 2 days of which 7 to load (3 livestock, 2 bulkers, 2 general cargo). 6 To discharge (3 bulkers, 2 tankers, 1 car carrier), 7 container vessels to load/discharge no delays expected.

SPAIN, Sept 9 - 23 Vessels in port (2 tankers, 19 dry cargo) of which 11 discharging, 7 loading/discharging, 5 loading no delays. Sagunto - 20 Vessels operating of which 13 discharging (10 steel products, 3 logs/timber), 3 loading (1 fertiliser, 1 cement, 1 steel products 3 ro/ros discharging/loading, 1 vessel discharging surgical products/loading general cargo. No vessels berthed outside commercial wharf, no berthing delays. Sept 10 - Cadiz - 14 Vessels operating of which 4 ro/ros, 1 passenger vessel, 2 wheat, 1 sugar, 1 clay, 1 semolina, 4 under repair, no delays. Pasajes - 18 Vessels in port of which 13 discharging (9 scrap, 1 petcoke, 1 fertiliser, 1 aluminium, 1 sawn timber), 1 discharging/loading cars, 4 loading steel, no delays. Aviles - No delays/congestion/strikes. Five vessels in port, 1 loading steel products, 4 discharging (1 scrap, 1 iron ore, 1 steel, 1 ammonia). Gijon - No delays/congestion/strikes. Four vessels operating of which 2 discharging (1 coal, 1 seeds), 2 loading (1 cement, 1 steel products).

TURKEY, Sept 10 - Istanbul - Haydar-Pasa - Twelve vessels operating (6 dry cargo, 5 containers, 1 ro/ro). No berthing delays except for heavy lift cargoes. Galata - 9 Cargo/passenger vessels operating, port congested. Ambarli - 14 Vessels operating, no berthing delays. Mersin - Fourteen vessels operating of which 6 loading (3 cement, 1 containers, 2 legumes). 4 Discharging (1 timber, 1 paraxylene, 1 soya bean oil, 1 barley), 4 loading/discharging (1 rolls/vehicles/containers, containers). 13 Vessels awaiting orders. Free zone piers - 2 Vessels discharging sugar. Seka - No vessels.

UKRAINE, Sept 9 - Mariupol - Nine vessels loading at berth (1 sun flower seeds, 3 fertiliser, 2 metal products, 1 sulphur, 1 coke, 1 coal). 7 Discharging at berth (3 fertiliser, 3 general cargo, 1 metal products). 2 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load (1 fertiliser, 1 metal products), 1 waiting to discharge general cargo. 8 Floating store-houses of which 7 fertiliser, 1 sulphur?. 1 Vessel under repair/dry-docked. 23 Vessels due by 25/9 of which 14 to load (6 coal, 1 sulphur, 5 metal products, 2 fertiliser), 5 to discharge/load general cargo, 4 to discharge (1 fertiliser, 1 alumina, 2 general cargo). Kerch - Two vessels loading at berth of which 1 metal products, 1 general cargo.

3 Vessels under repair/dry-docked. 1 Vessel due 9/9 to discharge vehicles. Berdyansk - Three vessels loading at berth (1 metal products, 1 mustard seed, 1 fertiliser), discharging at berth (both mustard seed). 1 Vessel waiting at anchorage to load metal products. Mariupol - Twelve vessels in port operating of which 10 loading (1 sun flower seeds, 5 fertiliser, 1 pipes, 2 steel, 1 coke), 1 discharging/loading containers/equipment, 1 discharging steel plates. 2 Vessels in roads, both to load, of which 1 fertiliser, 1 wire rods. 24 Vessels due of which 16 to load (7 coal, 1 sun flower seeds, 3 fertiliser, 4 steel, 1 metal). 7 To discharge (5 containers, 1 umina, 1 equipment), 1 to discharge/load equipment/containers.

Odessa - Eleven vessels in port of which 6 loading (1 fertiliser, 2 metal, 1 grain, 1 sun flower seeds, 1 oil), 2 discharging (1 general cargo, 1 flour). 1 Military visit, 1 vessel waiting, 1 under repairs. 11 Vessels in roads of which 5 to load (1 steel, 1 paper, 1 oil, 2 metal), 1 to discharge sugar, 1 awaiting cargo documents, 1 awaiting owner's notification, 3 waiting. 13 Vessels due of which 10 to load (7 metal, 1 fertiliser, 1 fuel oil, 1 sun flower seeds). 1 To discharge sugar, 1 to discharge/load containers, 1 passenger vessel.

Sept 10, Odessa - Steel cargoes (loading), 2 vessels berthed, 3 anchored, 5 due. Containers 1 vessel due. Grain cargoes (loading), 2 vessels berthed, 1 due. Sugar (discharging), 1 vessel anchored, 1 due. Tankers (loading), 1 vessel berthed, 1 anchored, 1 due. General cargo, 1 vessel berthed, 1 anchored. Fertiliser, 1 vessel berthed, 1 due. Ilichevsk - Steel cargoes (loading), 5 vessels berthed. Containers, 1 vessel berthed. General cargo, 1 vessel berthed.
